{{Quote|The Freeman, gone but not forgotten. Thank you for all your works of wonder. You will be missed.|The Freeman Memorial|<ref name="SWG:C11" />}}
'''The Freeman Memorial''' was a memorial set up inside the [[Adventurers' Guildhall]] at the [[Aurilia|Township of Aurilia]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It consisted of a [[Yanjon/Legends|Yanjon]] statue which commemorated someone who went by the alias, [[Freeman]].<ref name="SWG:C11" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Freeman Memorial appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:C11" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Freeman Memorial was added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 11|Chapter 11]] on [[November 20]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 11: The Battle of Echo Base">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68094&month=112008|text=Chapter 11: The Battle of Echo Base}}</ref> It honored the former lead gameplay designer [[Jeff Freeman]] who tragically took his life in 2008 at the age of 39.<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://www.engadget.com/2012-04-05-the-perfect-ten-mmo-tributes-to-real-life-people.html|text=The Perfect Ten: MMO tributes to real-life people|archivedate=20250404211251}}</ref>
